meaning_en: a little, to a small degree
example_en: I'm feeling a bit tired today.
examples_extra: The soup is a bit too salty for me.
He was a bit late because of the traffic.
note_fa: «a bit too + صفت یعنی «کمی زیادی»: a bit too cold.»

example_en: Can I have a little bit of water, please?
examples_extra: Could you speak a little more slowly?
I'm a little tired after the long walk.
note_fa: «a little bit = a little؛ هر دو یعنی «کمی».»

example_en: She shouted angrily at her brother.
examples_extra: 'Leave me alone!' she shouted angrily at him.
He slammed the door angrily and left.
note_fa: قید حالت؛ معمولاً بعد از فعل.

example_en: The weather was really bad yesterday.
examples_extra: The weather was so bad that we stayed inside all day.
Smoking is bad for your health and your teeth.
note_fa: در کتاب با good آموزش داده می‌شود — متضاد مستقیم آن good است.

meaning_en: In a poor or unsatisfactory way.
example_en: He sings badly, but he loves it.
examples_extra: The team played badly and lost the match three to nil.
He was badly hurt in the accident and stayed in hospital.

meaning_en: For a short time; in a few words.
meaning_fa: به طور خلاصه، برای مدت کوتاه
example_en: He spoke briefly about his trip.
examples_extra: She spoke only briefly about her future plans.
He paused briefly before answering the difficult question.

example_en: I completely forgot about the meeting.
examples_extra: The room was completely empty.
I completely forgot about our meeting yesterday.
note_fa: قبل از صفت یا فعل: completely different.

meaning_en: A level or amount of something.
example_en: There was a high degree of difficulty in the exam.
examples_extra: To some degree, I agree with your opinion.
The success of the plan depends on a high degree of cooperation.
note_fa: به معنای «درجه/میزان»؛ با to همراه: to a certain degree.

example_en: It was extremely cold last night.
examples_extra: It was extremely cold on the mountain.
She was extremely pleased with her exam results.

meaning_en: More than a little, but less than very.
example_en: The movie was fairly good.
examples_extra: The film was fairly good, but not great.
She did fairly well in the race.

example_en: He can run very fast.
examples_extra: The train goes very fast.
Time passes fast when you're happy.
note_fa: صفت و قیدش یک شکل است: a fast car / drive fast.

example_en: What is the frequency of these buses?
examples_extra: The frequency of buses here is very low.
What is the frequency of the radio station?

example_en: He frequently visits his grandparents.
examples_extra: She frequently visits her grandmother.
Buses run frequently in the city centre.

example_en: He has a friendly dog.
examples_extra: The neighbours are very friendly.
She gave me a friendly smile.

example_en: This is a very good book.
examples_extra: The food was very good.
She is a good teacher.

example_en: I hardly ever eat fast food.
examples_extra: She hardly ever watches TV on weekdays.
We hardly ever eat out because it is expensive.
note_fa: تقریباً هرگز؛ منفی است، not نمی‌خواهد.

example_en: The view from the mountain was incredibly beautiful.
examples_extra: The film was incredibly boring and far too long.
She runs incredibly fast for her age.

example_en: The music was too loud.
examples_extra: The music is too loud.
They heard a loud noise outside.

meaning_en: in a way that makes a lot of noise.
example_en: He spoke loudly so everyone could hear.
examples_extra: The children sang loudly at the concert.
She knocked loudly on the front door.
note_fa: کتاب: The children sang loudly؛ قید حالت.

meaning_en: The way something is done or happens.
example_en: She spoke in a polite manner.
examples_extra: She spoke in a polite manner.
His manner is very friendly.

example_en: I occasionally eat fast food.
examples_extra: We occasionally eat out at the weekend.
She occasionally visits her aunt in the village.

example_en: He asked politely for help.
examples_extra: He asked the question politely.
She smiled and nodded politely.

example_en: It's pretty cold outside today.
examples_extra: It's pretty cold outside today.
She's pretty good at tennis.

example_en: The library is a very quiet place.
examples_extra: Please be quiet; the baby is sleeping.
It's very quiet here tonight.

meaning_fa: به آرامی، بی سر و صدا
example_en: She closed the door quietly.
examples_extra: She spoke quietly so the baby would sleep.
He closed the door quietly.

meaning_en: a little or a lot, but not completely
example_en: The film was quite good.
examples_extra: The film was quite good.
I'm quite tired after the long walk.

example_en: We go to the park quite often.
examples_extra: I see her quite often.
We eat out quite often.

example_en: I rarely eat fast food.
examples_extra: She rarely eats meat these days.
It rarely snows here in winter.
note_fa: یعنی «به‌ندرت»؛ rarely ever هم رایج است.

example_en: It's rather cold today.
examples_extra: It's rather cold today, isn't it?
I'd rather stay home and read.

meaning_en: On the side that is not left.
example_en: Turn right at the traffic lights.
examples_extra: Turn right at the next traffic lights.
She guessed right on the final question.

example_en: Please show me the right way to do it.
examples_extra: Is this the right way to the station?
You are doing it the right way.
note_fa: the right way: مسیر یا روش درست.

example_en: We seldom go out on weekdays.
examples_extra: She seldom watches television these days.
We seldom go out in winter.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از rarely؛ معمولاً قبل از فعل می‌آید.

example_en: The weather is slightly warmer today.
examples_extra: The water is slightly cold.
He's slightly taller than me.

example_en: The internet is very slow.
examples_extra: This is a slow car.
The service was very slow.

example_en: He walked slowly to the door.
examples_extra: She walked slowly upstairs to bed.
Please speak a little more slowly.

example_en: The car stopped suddenly in front of us.
examples_extra: Suddenly, the lights went out.
He suddenly changed his mind.

example_en: I totally agree with your idea.
examples_extra: She was totally exhausted after the long race.
He felt totally lost in the big city.

meaning_en: In a way that is not kind or pleasant.
example_en: He spoke to me in an unfriendly way.
examples_extra: She spoke in an unfriendly way.
He behaved in an unfriendly way.
note_fa: قید است: in an unfriendly way یعنی به‌طرز غیردوستانه.

meaning_en: in a way that needs immediate attention
example_en: We need to leave urgently.
examples_extra: I must speak to her urgently.
We need your help urgently.

meaning_en: A method or style of doing something.
example_en: I like the way you sing.
examples_extra: There must be a better way forward together.
That's exactly the way to do it right.

example_en: I feel very well today.
examples_extra: I don't feel very well today.
She is well now., thankfully.

example_en: You are going the wrong way.
examples_extra: You gave the wrong answer.
We went the wrong way.

meaning_en: The showing of politeness in one's attitude.
example_en: He always treats his colleagues with courtesy.
examples_extra: Courtesy is still important nowadays.
She treats everyone with great courtesy.

meaning_en: The socially acceptable or expected way of behaving.
example_en: It's the done thing to send a thank-you note.
examples_extra: Generous tipping is the done thing in restaurants.
It is the done thing to send thanks.

meaning_en: The customary code of polite behavior in society.
example_en: Dining etiquette varies greatly across cultures.
examples_extra: Learn the local etiquette before you visit.
Good etiquette matters in business meetings.

meaning_en: To make a quick, nervous movement as from pain or fear.
example_en: He didn't flinch even when the loud noise startled everyone.
examples_extra: She flinched at the loud bang.
He didn't flinch under pressure.
note_fa: جا خوردن از ترس یا درد.

meaning_en: Showing a rude and arrogant lack of respect.
example_en: The student's insolent remarks angered the teacher.
examples_extra: The insolent boy ignored the teacher.
She gave an insolent reply.

meaning_en: Polite ways of behaving in social situations.
example_en: Good manners are essential when dining out.
examples_extra: The children must mind their manners at the table.
That rude dinner guest has no manners at all.

meaning_en: The correct or acceptable way of communicating online.
example_en: Good netiquette includes not typing in all caps.
examples_extra: Please follow basic online netiquette rules here.
Good netiquette matters greatly in online forums.

meaning_en: Show surprise or disapproval by lifting your eyebrows.
example_en: His unusual suggestion made everyone raise their eyebrows.
examples_extra: She raised her eyebrows in surprise.
His strange answer raised many eyebrows.

meaning_en: To smile in an arrogant or self-satisfied way.
example_en: He smirked when he heard the news.
examples_extra: He smirked at my mistake.
She gave a nasty smirk.

meaning_en: To show disapproval or disdain for something.
example_en: She wouldn't sniff at a free meal.
examples_extra: She sniffed at the offer.
He sniffed at their expensive wine.

meaning_en: Make a loud sound by forcing air through nose.
example_en: The horse snorted loudly, sensing danger nearby.
examples_extra: He snorted loudly with laughter.
She snorted in disgust and left.
note_fa: یعنی خرناس کشیدن (از خنده یا نفرت).

meaning_en: To wriggle or twist body movements, often from discomfort.
meaning_fa: وول خوردن، پیچ و تاب خوردن
example_en: The child squirmed uncomfortably in his seat.
examples_extra: He squirmed in his chair.
The child squirmed uncomfortably in bed.

meaning_en: To insist on formal behavior or etiquette.
meaning_fa: تعارف کردن، تشریفات را رعایت کردن
example_en: Please don't stand on ceremony; just make yourself at home.
examples_extra: There is no need to stand on ceremony.
Please do not stand on ceremony.

meaning_en: Having very strict moral attitudes and conventional behavior.
example_en: His straitlaced parents disapproved of his tattoos.
examples_extra: Her straitlaced parents disapproved of dancing.
He comes from a straitlaced family.

example_en: The students began to titter when the teacher stumbled.
examples_extra: The whole class tittered nervously.
They tittered at his mistake.
